=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:154-392 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `head -c` truncates Semble query files by bytes, which can split multi-byte UTF-8 characters before the text is passed to `semble_query_block`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers confirmed the same byte-vs-character bug, and the query content can include non-ASCII user text.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:73-118 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `head -c` truncates the review-blocked judge query by bytes, which can split UTF-8 characters and feed malformed text to `semble_query_block`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported the same bug at this call site, and the input can contain user-authored non-ASCII content.
- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:1-146 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The new Semble prefetch contract test is not wired into any CI or release-gating workflow.
  WHY: All reviewers who checked the workflows found no automation entry for this test, so regressions in the wiring will escape CI.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:351-445 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `build_diagnose_semble_query` can produce an empty or low-signal Semble query because the extractor is too narrow and suppresses errors.
  WHY: When the failure tail lacks the expected identifiers, the heredoc still succeeds but yields weak context instead of failing closed.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:390-450 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The identifier extractor misses path-like tokens without dots and uses stop words that are too aggressive, which weakens the Semble query.
  WHY: Failures that mention bare scripts or path segments can lose signal before the query is sent.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:480-482 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The Semble enrichment call site only checks for a non-empty file, so a near-empty query still reaches `semble_query_block` and no-op behavior is silent.
  WHY: The guard does not verify that the query has meaningful content before attempting enrichment.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:320-415 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_normalize_semble_max_chunks()` is invoked unconditionally in `emit_context()`, even when Semble will not be used.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the call is harmless but redundant, so it is a low-impact correctness-adjacent cleanup issue.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-230 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `issue_meta_matches_issue()` assumes `ISSUE_META_FILE` always contains `.number`, which can make the cached-issue guard fail on soft-fail or stale metadata.
  WHY: The jq comparison depends on a field that is not guaranteed to exist in 404/soft-fail issue metadata.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
